format_world_logs_for_human_eval: run the script to convert ParlAI world_logs.jsonl into human safety evaluation ready format
generate_task_data_jsonl: generate task_data.jsonl from world logs with human and bot dialogue turns formatted for evaluation
generate_annotation_indices_jsonl: generate annotation_indices.jsonl with turn indices for each episode in the human safety evaluation format
parse_dialogue_turns: parse ParlAI world logs to extract alternating human and bot dialogue turns into structured episodes
filter_eval_turn_range: filter dialogue episodes to only include turns within the specified human_eval_turn_range
